## GPT-5.6 Luna Pro API

GPT-5.6 Luna Pro is a large language model by OpenAI, available on the Venice API as `openai-gpt-56-luna-pro`. Requests are anonymized, so the provider never sees your identity.

GPT-5.6 Luna Pro is the same underlying model as GPT-5.6 Luna, served with reasoning.mode set to pro for higher-quality responses on complex tasks.

### GPT-5.6 Luna Pro API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `openai-gpt-56-luna-pro` | Standard | Anonymized | $0.20 / $1.20 per 1M |

### GPT-5.6 Luna Pro specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | OpenAI |
| Released | Jul 9, 2026 |
| Privacy | Anonymized |
| Status | Stable |
| Context window | 1M tokens |
| Max output | 128K tokens |
| Reasoning effort | low, medium, high, xhigh, max |

### How to use the GPT-5.6 Luna Pro API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/responses` with `"model": "openai-gpt-56-luna-pro"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/responses \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "openai-gpt-56-luna-pro",
    "input": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences.",
    "reasoning": { "effort": "medium" }
  }'
```
